systems.owner: Ministry of Interior staff, supported by PRODIGY (World Bank and Global Financing Facility)
systems.tiers: more than 2,000 mobile teams with biometric kits since April 2026, 26 days a month, feeding a de-duplicated biometric database; over 3.25 million adults enrolled as of 10 June 2026; a law of 28 May 2026 lets births be registered en masse within the operation

note: Describes the identity enrolment campaign and the law letting it lead to birth certificates for adults; says births are registered in about 1,700 communes but does not say how a commune office makes the record.
